checks.name: email registration, OPAQUE password login and email confirmation
upload blocked until passkey recovery is enrolled
real browser WebAuthn registration, PRF and verified activation
upload encrypts and download decrypts exact original bytes
image preview uses browser-decrypted blob URL
HTTP API exposes encrypted bytes and encrypted filename metadata
list/grid, light/dark and widths 1280/390/320 have no horizontal overflow
password change rewraps same vault and preserves file bytes
new isolated browser context opens same files using password, without prior device state
passkey + PRF opens files after browser session cookies are removed
forgotten password recovered through passkey without changing files
tampered encrypted download fails authentication and never produces a plaintext download
TOTP enrollment requires password proof and a valid generator code
password plus TOTP replaces email code and opens same files; no session before code verification
explicit email reset destroys vault and passkey/TOTP bindings, invalidates other sessions and removes old file access
after destructive reset, new password/passkey protects a new empty vault and accepts new encrypted uploads
captured browser requests never contain plaintext passwords, file content or filename

limits: Synthetic Chrome virtual authenticator, not actual Apple/Google cloud synchronization.
No independent security audit or production load test.
Screenshots and input files contain synthetic data only.
